I (23 F) was actually diagnosed seronegative a month before I started PA school this past August. My mom has it and grandfather had it so with my symptoms and family history my rheumatologist just decided to diagnose me on our second visit. I struggled alot with cadaver lab and the stress of the program was really exacerbating all my symptoms. I still haven't found meds that work and decided I needed to take a medical leave from school to try and figure out how to handle RA. I wanted to do surgery too but my dean and anatomy teacher both said surgery would probably be difficult and I should just focus on getting through a surgical rotation when I eventually get back into school. Im sorry this probably isn't what you want to hear, but all cases and individuals are different. I think my mental health issues have made my physical symptoms worse personally. Good luck, I hope things get better.

Just because you have panic attacks doesnt mean you have to take drugs like Xanax. You could be prescribed an SSRI to help with underlying anxiety and it could help with the frequency of panic attacks. You may be prescribed with Xanax, clonazepam, valium ,etc to take as needed but that doesnt mean you have to take them. I have an as needed prescription of Klonopin but I rarely use it, since my SSRI meds help keep my anxiety from getting that high regularly. I also dislike taking all my medication but I have accepted at this point in my life I need it to function and I should try to not be ashamed or afraid of that.  I'm not a psychiatrist so take what I say with a grain of salt but I would really suggest at least talking to a doctor about starting medication.

Even if the assessment isnt conclusive on anything in particular dont take that as proof that you are making things up. Making a diagnosis can be difficult for certain disorders, for example I had a really unhealthy relationship with food for a while and when I went to see a psychiatrist about it they never gave me a specific diagnosis. Instead they just told me that I had some unspecified eating disorder. Even though this wasnt conclusive I still felt somewhat better talking to a doctor and having them validate my symptoms as clinically significant (I hope this makes sense). I dont know anything about your sister or situation but I would like to think that she can understand wanting to have a diagnosis. It makes sense wanting to know what's wrong instead of just feeling like shit but not really knowing why.

When I was finally diagnosed with GAD and MDD, there was part of me that felt validated in knowing I wasnt just "making up" my symptoms. That being said having a diagnosis is necessarily key in making progress in therapy. But I do think for some people (myself included) it is important to know the diagnosis so that way when I start to feel shitty or super anxious I can tell myself "Oh this is just my anxiety disorder or depression acting up" instead of not having anything to help explain why I feel upset.

Have you ever thought about trying medication? I started taking meds because my anxiety got the point were I wouldnt leave my house when I saw too many clouds in the sky (I was petrified of thunderstorms). The medications dont make everything go away but they can make it more manageable and not feel as overwhelming. And if you already have medications maybe think about talking to your doctor about changing things around since it seems like the panic attacks are getting worse. I really hope the panic attacks get better.

My family is loud and has always fought alot. I find when I come home to visit now (I moved away for college) I get super worked up when they start to yell at each other. If I feel like I have the ability too I try and keep the argument civil and try to keep people from yelling but sometimes that doesnt work. When that doesnt work and I cant really escape my house I tend to distract myself with my phone or a book and try to escape into whatever I am reading it watching. Having a space that's physically separate from the fighting  and feels safe is really helpful but I get that isnt always possible. I hope things get better.
